notes: Due dates. Add the day of the month each account is due and a new Coming Up card shows what’s close, with a one-tap way to log the payment right from it. Nothing is assumed — accounts you don’t give a day to are simply left alone.

Premium: recurring bills. Rent, utilities, insurance, subscriptions — add them with their due days and they appear alongside your debt payments in Coming Up, so you’re looking at everything that’s due in one place. Tick one off once you’ve handled it.

Monthly Money Plan. Set what you can put toward debts and bills each month, and see it beside what you’ve actually committed. It’s a check on your plan — it doesn’t change your payoff date or any of your numbers.
